User ownership decision, 2026-09-12: reserve M0.02 (bd-01M2BNEA7C953AXD5FJ8YDNW9R) and M0.03 (bd-01M2BNEC4NBXSN193PFS0Q5BCR) for scalafim-umvpa-foundation-lead. These are the two selected early high-risk work packets: immutable provider composition/admission, then executable runtime identity/dependent-space/zero-read inspection prototypes. Both are assigned and labeled umvpa-lead-owned so the rest can be delegated without overlap. No delegated worker should duplicate these packets.

Also assign final integration review M5.07 (bd-01M2BNJ83NZBEVM6FVPAXKG227) to this lead. The final review must inspect the actual integrated implementation, exact pins and artifacts, reproduce independent checks, examine leakage/identity/representation/numerical/statistical/resource boundaries and legacy absence, and return unresolved findings to their owners. Do not accept summaries or ticket closure as evidence. Separate M0.07/M4.09/M5.04 independent audits remain delegated; lead review does not replace them or independently certify its own implementation.

Immediate delegation priority: M0.01 bd-01M2BNE82Q1NJADVWB3ECXRXWD is still open/unassigned and blocks M0.02. Preserve that edge and the M0.02 -> M0.03 admission order. Source investigation is underway, but no contract, implementation, provider pin or gate has been declared admitted. There is no active production-code edit or broad path reservation from this selection.
